cards.questionEn: What pre-takeoff preparations should a flight crew make in the winter conditions shown?
cards.questionZh: 在图中所示的冬季条件下起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.answerEn: I would brief the winter-weather threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.answerZh: 我会对冬季天气威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.questionEn: What is foreign object debris (FOD), and why is it hazardous?
cards.questionZh: 什么是外来物（FOD）？它为什么危险？
cards.answerEn: FOD means foreign object debris or foreign object damage. It is hazardous because it can damage tyres, engines, and aircraft structures. Ramp inspections and runway cleaning are therefore important.
cards.answerZh: FOD 指外来物碎片或外来物损伤。它会危及安全，因为可能损坏轮胎、发动机和飞机结构。因此，机坪检查和跑道清扫十分重要。

cards.questionEn: As captain, how would you respond to a suspected bird strike in flight?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，怀疑飞行中发生鸟击时，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.answerZh: 我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.questionEn: What are the main hazards of flying at night?
cards.questionZh: 夜间飞行的主要危险有哪些？
cards.answerEn: The main hazards are reduced visibility, higher cockpit workload, spatial disorientation, and difficulty judging terrain or clouds.
cards.answerZh: 主要风险包括能见度降低、驾驶舱工作负荷增大、空间定向障碍，以及难以判断地形或云层。

cards.questionEn: What preparations should pilots make before a night flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行员在夜间飞行前应做哪些准备？
cards.answerEn: Before a night flight, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the flight.
cards.answerZh: 夜间飞行前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟飞行。

cards.questionEn: How can ice on a wing affect flight safety?
cards.questionZh: 机翼结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.answerEn: Ice on a wing can reduce lift, increase drag, raise the stall speed, and cause possible control problems. These effects may reduce safety margins.
cards.answerZh: 机翼结冰会减小升力、增大阻力、提高失速速度，并可能导致操纵问题。这些影响会降低安全裕度。

cards.questionEn: What should a pilot do if ice or frost is found on the wings before departure?
cards.questionZh: 起飞前如果发现机翼上有冰或霜，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would identify the wing contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.answerZh: 我会识别机翼污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.questionEn: What preparations should a flight crew make before taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.questionZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.answerEn: Before the night takeoff, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.answerZh: 夜间起飞前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.questionEn: What hazards should pilots consider when taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.questionZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞时，飞行员应考虑哪些危险？
cards.answerEn: At night, reduced visibility makes it harder to judge height, distance, terrain, and clouds. Spatial disorientation and higher cockpit workload can make the takeoff and departure more demanding. A thorough briefing and a careful instrument cross-check help control these risks.

editActions: applied only the locked night-flight hazard themes to the takeoff context
kept the mitigation concise and operationally general
provenance.riskAssessment: The answer lists common night-takeoff hazards without assuming airport-specific terrain, lighting, or weather.

cards.answerZh: 夜间能见度较低，更难判断高度、距离、地形和云层。空间定向障碍和较高的驾驶舱工作负荷会使起飞和离场更具挑战。充分的简令和谨慎的仪表交叉检查有助于控制这些风险。

cards.questionEn: What types of runway lighting help pilots during takeoff and landing at night?
cards.questionZh: 哪些类型的跑道灯光可以在夜间起飞和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.answerEn: Approach lights and runway-end identifier lights help pilots find and align with the runway. Threshold, edge, centerline, and touchdown-zone lights show the runway's position and usable landing area. Runway-end lights and visual glide-slope indicators provide additional guidance during landing, while edge and centerline lights also support takeoff.

officialSources.title: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual, Airport Lighting Aids

editActions: grouped the main lighting systems by their practical function
kept the list focused on takeoff and landing at night
provenance.riskAssessment: Lighting installations vary by airport and runway, so the answer names common systems without implying that every runway has all of them.

cards.answerZh: 进近灯和跑道入口识别灯帮助飞行员找到跑道并与跑道对正。入口灯、边灯、中线灯和接地区灯显示跑道位置及可用着陆区域。跑道末端灯和目视下滑指示器在着陆时提供进一步引导，而边灯和中线灯也为起飞提供支持。

cards.questionEn: If you were the captain of one of these aircraft, how would you respond to the risk of a collision?
cards.questionZh: 如果你是图中其中一架航空器的机长，你会如何应对碰撞风险？
cards.answerEn: I would recognize the risk as early as possible, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.answerZh: 我会尽早识别风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.questionEn: What factors can cause aircraft to come dangerously close to each other?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器彼此危险接近？
cards.answerEn: Possible factors include loss of separation, wake turbulence, a runway incursion, or a misunderstanding of ATC instructions. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute.
cards.answerZh: 可能的因素包括间隔丧失、尾流、跑道侵入，或对空中交通管制指令的误解。人的因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题也可能起到作用。

cards.questionEn: What appears to have happened to the landing gear of the aircraft in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 图中航空器的起落架似乎发生了什么？
cards.answerEn: The aircraft appears to be sitting unusually low, and the main landing gear area seems to be under inspection. This suggests that part of the landing gear may have collapsed or failed to support the aircraft properly. The exact fault cannot be confirmed from the picture alone.

provenance.imageObservation: A large passenger aircraft is stationary on the apron and appears unusually low near the main landing gear area, where ground personnel and equipment are present.
editActions: identified the abnormal aircraft attitude
qualified the possible gear collapse because the precise failure is not visually certain
provenance.riskAssessment: The image supports a suspected landing-gear problem but not a definite diagnosis, so the answer avoids naming a specific failed component.

cards.answerZh: 飞机看起来位置异常低，主起落架区域似乎正在接受检查。这表明部分起落架可能已经坍塌，或未能正常支撑飞机。仅凭图片无法确认具体故障。

cards.questionEn: What can cause an aircraft's landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起落架在地面坍塌或收起？
cards.answerEn: A mechanical failure or a maintenance error can cause the landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground.
cards.answerZh: 机械故障或维修差错可能导致起落架在地面坍塌或意外收起。

cards.questionEn: What consequences can result from a landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground?
cards.questionZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成哪些后果？
cards.answerEn: A landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground can cause serious structural damage.
cards.answerZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成严重的结构损伤。

cards.questionEn: What challenges do pilots face when operating in the winter weather shown?
cards.questionZh: 在图中所示的冬季天气下运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.answerEn: The main challenges are contaminated surfaces, low visibility, reduced braking action, and de-icing requirements.
cards.answerZh: 主要挑战包括道面污染、低能见度、制动作用降低，以及除冰要求。

cards.questionEn: What is meant by a high-altitude airport?
cards.questionZh: 什么是高海拔机场？
cards.answerEn: A high-altitude airport is located at a high elevation above sea level. Because the air is thinner, aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance must be checked carefully.
cards.answerZh: 高海拔机场位于海拔较高的位置。由于空气较稀薄，必须仔细检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.questionEn: If you had to land at the high-altitude airport shown, how would you prepare for a safe arrival?
cards.questionZh: 如果必须在图中所示的高海拔机场着陆，你会如何为安全到达做准备？
cards.answerEn: Because the air is thinner at a high-altitude airport, I would check the aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance very carefully before arrival.
cards.answerZh: 由于高海拔机场空气较稀薄，我会在到达前非常仔细地检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.questionEn: What challenges do pilots face when operating at high-altitude airports?
cards.questionZh: 在高海拔机场运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.answerEn: Pilots face thin air, longer landing distances, reduced engine performance, and terrain restrictions.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员面临的挑战包括空气稀薄、着陆距离增加、发动机性能下降和地形限制。

cards.questionEn: What can you see in the simulator training scene shown in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 你能从图中的模拟机训练场景中看到什么？
cards.answerEn: I can see two pilots seated in a full-flight simulator. The cockpit has realistic flight instruments, controls, and outside visual displays. They appear to be practising normal or abnormal procedures in a controlled training environment.

provenance.imageObservation: Two people are seated at the controls of an enclosed flight simulator with illuminated cockpit displays and a projected outside scene.
editActions: described the visible simulator and trainees
used a qualified statement for the type of training
provenance.riskAssessment: The exact exercise cannot be identified from the image, so the answer says normal or abnormal procedures rather than claiming a specific scenario.

cards.answerZh: 我看到两名飞行员坐在全动飞行模拟机内。驾驶舱配有逼真的飞行仪表、操纵装置和外部视景显示。他们似乎正在受控的训练环境中练习正常或非正常程序。

cards.questionEn: What are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.questionZh: 模拟机训练有哪些好处？
cards.answerEn: Simulator training can improve situational awareness. It gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and gives them more time to make safe decisions.
cards.answerZh: 模拟机训练可以提高情景意识。它能为飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.questionEn: What are the main differences between a cockpit with traditional flight instruments and a modern glass cockpit?
cards.questionZh: 采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱与现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要区别？
cards.answerEn: Compared with traditional flight instruments, a modern glass cockpit gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions. This can improve situational awareness.
cards.answerZh: 与传统飞行仪表相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。这有助于提高情景意识。

cards.questionEn: What challenges do pilots face when flying an aircraft with traditional flight instruments?
cards.questionZh: 驾驶采用传统飞行仪表的航空器时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.answerEn: Traditional flight instruments can create a higher scan workload, provide less integrated information, and require more manual cross-checking.
cards.answerZh: 传统飞行仪表可能增加仪表扫描工作量，提供的综合信息较少，并要求飞行员进行更多人工交叉检查。

cards.questionEn: What damage can you see on the aircraft in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 这张图片中的飞机有哪些损伤？
cards.answerEn: The cowling around one engine is open or partly missing, and internal components are exposed. The nacelle area appears to be damaged. The picture does not provide enough detail to determine the cause or the full extent of the damage.

provenance.imageObservation: The panels around an engine nacelle are open, displaced, or absent, leaving internal engine-area components visible.
editActions: identified the visible cowling and nacelle condition
avoided diagnosing the cause from a single image
provenance.riskAssessment: The visible condition is consistent with cowling damage or an opened cowling, but the image cannot show whether maintenance activity or an in-flight event caused it.

cards.answerZh: 一台发动机周围的整流罩已经打开或部分缺失，内部部件暴露在外。短舱区域看起来已经受损。图片细节不足，无法判断损伤原因和完整范围。

cards.questionEn: What actions should a pilot take if engine cowling damage occurs during cruise?
cards.questionZh: 巡航过程中如果发动机整流罩发生损坏，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.answerEn: I would monitor the aircraft carefully for engine vibration, possible debris, performance loss, or further structural damage. I would be ready to take conservative action if these risks reduced the safety margin.
cards.answerZh: 我会密切监控飞机，注意发动机振动、可能的碎片、性能下降或进一步的结构损伤。如果这些风险降低了安全裕度，我会准备采取保守措施。

cards.questionEn: What inspections should be performed to help prevent engine cowling failures?
cards.questionZh: 应进行哪些检查，以帮助防止发动机整流罩失效？
cards.answerEn: The preflight inspection should check that every cowling panel is correctly seated and that all latches and fasteners are secure. Maintenance inspections should look for worn hinges, damaged fasteners, cracks, distortion, and previous repairs. After maintenance work, the cowling should be closed, documented, and independently checked as required.

editActions: separated flight-crew walk-around checks from maintenance inspections
added a post-maintenance closure check without prescribing a type-specific task
provenance.riskAssessment: Cowling designs and inspection intervals vary by aircraft, so the answer avoids naming particular fastener types or maintenance limits.

cards.answerZh: 飞行前检查应确认每块整流罩面板都正确就位，所有锁扣和紧固件均已固定。维修检查应查找铰链磨损、紧固件损坏、裂纹、变形和既往修理痕迹。维修工作完成后，应按要求关闭整流罩、做好记录并进行独立复查。

cards.questionEn: What can you see in this picture of a tail-mounted engine fire?
cards.questionZh: 你能从这张尾置发动机起火的图片中看到什么？
cards.answerEn: The picture shows flames and dark smoke coming from the rear engine of a three-engine aircraft. The fire appears to be concentrated around the tail-mounted engine. The exact cause of the fire is not visible.

provenance.imageObservation: Flames and smoke are visible around the tail-mounted engine of a three-engine passenger aircraft.
editActions: described the visible location of the fire
stated the limit of what can be determined from the image
provenance.riskAssessment: The fire location is visually clear, but the answer does not claim a cause, consequence, or unseen system damage.

cards.answerZh: 图片中，一架三发飞机的后部发动机冒出火焰和浓烟。火势似乎集中在尾置发动机周围。图片无法显示起火的确切原因。

cards.questionEn: What risks can a fire in a tail-mounted engine pose to an aircraft and its occupants?
cards.questionZh: 尾置发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.answerEn: The main risks are smoke, fire spreading, system damage, passenger panic, and a possible evacuation.
cards.answerZh: 主要风险包括烟雾、火势蔓延、系统损坏、旅客恐慌，以及可能需要撤离。

cards.questionEn: As the pilot in command, how would you respond to the tail-mounted engine fire shown in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，你会如何处置图中所示的尾置发动机起火？
cards.answerEn: For the tail-mounted engine fire, I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.answerZh: 对于尾置发动机起火，我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.questionEn: What measures can help reduce the risk of an in-flight engine fire?
cards.questionZh: 哪些措施可以降低发动机在飞行中起火的风险？
cards.answerEn: Regular maintenance should detect fuel, oil, and hydraulic leaks and any damage to engine wiring or hot sections. Crews should complete careful preflight inspections, monitor engine indications, and respond promptly to abnormal temperatures, vibration, or warning messages. Good FOD control and correct engine-start procedures also reduce the risk.

editActions: covered maintenance, crew monitoring, and ground prevention measures
kept the controls general rather than engine-type-specific
provenance.riskAssessment: The causes of engine fires vary widely, so the answer presents broad preventive barriers without claiming that they eliminate all risk.

cards.answerZh: 定期维修应发现燃油、滑油和液压油泄漏，以及发动机线路或高温部件的损伤。机组应认真完成飞行前检查，监控发动机指示，并及时处置温度异常、振动或警告信息。良好的外来物管理和正确的发动机起动程序也能降低风险。

cards.questionEn: What can you see in the aircraft queue shown in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 你能从图中的航空器排队场景中看到什么？
cards.answerEn: Several passenger aircraft are lined up one behind another on a taxiway or apron. Their noses point in the same direction, and the aircraft are fairly close together. The picture clearly shows a queue, but it does not show why the queue has formed.

provenance.imageObservation: Several passenger aircraft are positioned in a line on the airport movement area.
editActions: described the visible aircraft queue
avoided inferring the cause or purpose of the queue
provenance.riskAssessment: The reason for the queue is not visible, so the answer makes no claim about clearance, runway availability, traffic, or delay.

cards.answerZh: 数架客机在滑行道或机坪上首尾排成一列，机头朝向相同，飞机之间距离较近。图片清楚显示飞机正在排队，但没有显示排队原因。

cards.questionEn: What can cause aircraft to queue on a taxiway before takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起飞前在滑行道上排队等候？
cards.answerEn: Possible contributors to taxiway congestion include human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems.
cards.answerZh: 造成滑行道拥堵的因素可能包括人为因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题。

cards.questionEn: What risks can arise when aircraft wait on the ground for an extended period before takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 航空器在起飞前长时间停留在地面可能产生哪些风险？
cards.answerEn: A long ground wait can increase fuel burn, brake heating, congestion, exposure to foreign object debris, and crew workload. These risks can reduce safety margins.
cards.answerZh: 长时间地面等待会增加燃油消耗、刹车温度、拥堵、外来物暴露和机组工作负荷。这些风险可能降低安全裕度。

cards.questionEn: How can long ground queues before takeoff be managed or reduced?
cards.questionZh: 如何管理或减少起飞前的长时间地面排队？
cards.answerEn: Airports and ATC can reduce queues through better departure sequencing, traffic-flow planning, and timely information about restrictions. Airlines can hold an aircraft at the gate or delay engine start when a long wait is expected. During a queue, the crew should monitor fuel, brake temperature, weather, and duty time and coordinate any change of plan.

editActions: addressed both system-level queue reduction and crew-level management
used the existing ground-wait risk themes without adding fixed limits
provenance.riskAssessment: Gate holding and engine-start decisions depend on airport and company procedures; the answer presents them as available measures, not universal instructions.

cards.answerZh: 机场和空中交通管制可以通过优化离场排序、流量规划，并及时提供限制信息来减少排队。航空公司预计等待时间较长时，可以让飞机留在登机口或推迟起动发动机。排队期间，机组应监控燃油、刹车温度、天气和值勤时间，并协调任何计划变更。

cards.questionEn: What measures can reduce the risk of foreign object debris being ingested by an aircraft engine?
cards.questionZh: 哪些措施可以降低航空器发动机吸入外来物的风险？
cards.answerEn: Airport operators should inspect and clean runways, taxiways, and aprons regularly. Airlines need good housekeeping and tool-control procedures, while crews should check the engine intake and nearby ground area during the walk-around. Pilots should also avoid using high thrust where loose debris may be drawn into an engine.

editActions: expanded the existing FOD prevention theme across airport, maintenance, and crew responsibilities
added a conservative thrust-use precaution
provenance.riskAssessment: Local ramp layouts and engine-clearance procedures vary, so no distance or thrust setting is specified.

cards.answerZh: 机场运营方应定期检查并清扫跑道、滑行道和机坪。航空公司需要做好现场管理和工具管控，机组则应在绕机检查时查看发动机进气口及附近地面。飞行员还应避免在松散碎片可能被吸入发动机的区域使用大推力。

cards.questionEn: What are the main advantages of a modern glass cockpit over a cockpit with traditional flight instruments?
cards.questionZh: 与采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要优势？
cards.answerEn: A modern glass cockpit can improve situational awareness. Compared with traditional flight instruments, it gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions.
cards.answerZh: 现代玻璃驾驶舱可以提高情景意识。与传统飞行仪表相比，它向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.questionEn: How do multiple display screens help pilots manage a flight?
cards.questionZh: 多个显示屏如何帮助飞行员管理飞行？
cards.answerEn: Multiple screens can present flight, navigation, engine, system, and weather information in an organized way. They help both pilots monitor the same situation, compare information, and notice abnormal conditions quickly. Separate displays also provide useful redundancy, although the crew must still cross-check them and understand any display failure.

editActions: expanded the glass-cockpit benefit into specific information groups
balanced the advantages with a monitoring limitation
provenance.riskAssessment: Display architecture differs by aircraft, so the answer avoids claiming that every screen is fully independent or interchangeable.

cards.answerZh: 多个显示屏可以有序呈现飞行、导航、发动机、系统和天气信息。它们有助于两名飞行员监控同一情况、比对信息并迅速发现异常。独立显示屏还能提供一定冗余，但机组仍须交叉检查，并了解显示故障的影响。

cards.questionEn: What types of aircraft damage can result from a poorly controlled landing in a strong crosswind?
cards.questionZh: 在强侧风中着陆控制不当可能对航空器造成哪些损伤？
cards.answerEn: A poorly controlled crosswind landing can place excessive side loads on the landing gear and damage tyres, wheels, or gear components. A hard or sideways touchdown may also damage the wing, engine nacelle, tail, or fuselage if any part strikes the runway. Severe loads can cause structural damage that requires a detailed inspection.

editActions: identified common load-related and runway-contact damage
avoided assigning a specific damage pattern to every crosswind event
provenance.riskAssessment: Actual damage depends on aircraft geometry, touchdown attitude, speed, and load, so the answer uses conditional language.

cards.answerZh: 侧风着陆操纵不当会使起落架承受过大的侧向载荷，并损坏轮胎、机轮或起落架部件。重着陆或带侧滑接地还可能使机翼、发动机短舱、机尾或机身撞击跑道而受损。严重载荷可能造成需要详细检查的结构损伤。

cards.questionEn: As captain, how would you prepare for an approach when strong crosswinds are reported?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，接到强侧风报告后，你会如何为进近做准备？
cards.answerEn: Before the approach, I would brief the crosswind threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the approach or divert as appropriate.
cards.answerZh: 进近前，我会对侧风威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟进近或视情况改航。

cards.questionEn: As captain, how would you manage an approach if you encountered stronger-than-expected crosswinds?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，如果进近中遇到比预期更强的侧风，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured in the stronger crosswind, I would go around or divert as appropriate.
cards.answerZh: 我会检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果更强的侧风下无法确保安全，我会复飞或视情况改航。

cards.questionEn: What can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器发动机在地面运行期间起火？
cards.answerEn: Fuel leakage or overheating can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations.
cards.answerZh: 燃油泄漏或过热可能导致飞机在地面运行期间发生发动机火灾。

cards.questionEn: What risks can an engine fire during taxi pose to the aircraft and its occupants?
cards.questionZh: 滑行期间发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.answerEn: An engine fire during taxi may create smoke and an evacuation risk. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.answerZh: 滑行期间发动机起火可能产生烟雾，并带来撤离风险。这些风险可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.questionEn: What preflight inspections can help reduce the risk of an engine fire during ground operations?
cards.questionZh: 哪些飞行前检查可以帮助降低发动机在地面运行期间起火的风险？
cards.answerEn: The walk-around should look for fuel, oil, or hydraulic leaks, damaged wiring, loose panels, and signs of overheating around the engine. The crew should confirm that the nacelle and cowling are secure and that the intake is clear of FOD. Required maintenance checks should also confirm that the fire-detection and extinguishing systems are serviceable.

editActions: built the inspection around the existing leak, overheating, and FOD causes
distinguished visible preflight checks from required system maintenance
provenance.riskAssessment: Flight crews cannot verify every internal component during a walk-around, so the answer does not imply that a visual check replaces maintenance.

cards.answerZh: 绕机检查应查找燃油、滑油或液压油泄漏、线路损坏、面板松动，以及发动机周围的过热迹象。机组应确认短舱和整流罩固定可靠，进气口内没有外来物。规定的维修检查还应确认火警探测和灭火系统工作正常。

cards.questionEn: As captain, how would you respond to an engine fire detected during takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，起飞过程中发现发动机起火时，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: If the fire warning occurred before the takeoff decision speed and the aircraft could stop safely, I would reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue the takeoff, maintain control, climb safely, and then complete the engine-fire memory actions and checklist. I would declare an emergency and arrange the earliest safe landing, treating a continuing fire as an immediate threat.

officialSources.title: FAA Airplane Flying Handbook, Transition to Jet-Powered Airplanes
FAA AC 120-114, Pilot Training and Checking

editActions: made the response conditional on the takeoff decision speed
kept post-liftoff actions general and checklist-based
provenance.riskAssessment: Rejected-takeoff criteria and fire actions are aircraft- and operator-specific; the answer states the V1 principle without inventing detailed memory items.

cards.answerZh: 如果火警出现在起飞决断速度之前，且飞机能够安全停下，我会按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，控制好飞机并安全爬升，然后完成发动机火警记忆项目和检查单。我会宣布紧急状态并安排尽早安全着陆，把持续燃烧的火情视为直接威胁。

cards.questionEn: What types of serious failures could make it necessary for a large passenger aircraft to ditch at sea?
cards.questionZh: 哪些严重故障可能使大型客机必须在海上迫降？
cards.answerEn: A ditching may become necessary after a total or major loss of engine thrust when no runway is within reach. Other possible reasons include an uncontrollable fire, fuel exhaustion, severe structural or flight-control damage, or the loss of essential systems. The crew would consider ditching only when continued flight or a safe landing on land was no longer possible.

editActions: listed serious failures capable of removing a safe land option
made clear that ditching is a last-resort decision
provenance.riskAssessment: The same failure may not require ditching if a runway remains reachable, so the answer ties the decision to the absence of a safer landing option.

cards.answerZh: 当发动机推力全部或大部分丧失，且没有可到达的跑道时，可能需要水上迫降。其他可能原因包括无法控制的火灾、燃油耗尽、严重的结构或飞行操纵损伤，以及关键系统丧失。只有在无法继续飞行或无法在陆地安全着陆时，机组才会考虑水上迫降。

cards.questionEn: As captain, how would you manage a total loss of engine power over water if ditching became unavoidable?
cards.questionZh: 作为机长，如果航空器在水域上空丧失全部发动机动力且水上迫降已无法避免，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist.
cards.answerZh: 我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。

cards.questionEn: What should the flight crew do to evacuate an aircraft after a ditching?
cards.questionZh: 水上迫降后，飞行机组应如何组织人员撤离航空器？
cards.answerEn: After the aircraft stops, the pilots should secure it as required and order an evacuation if remaining on board is unsafe. The crew should use only exits that are above the water and free from hazards, deploy the available slide-rafts or life rafts, and direct occupants to leave baggage behind. Everyone should move into the rafts, stay together, and use the survival and signalling equipment.

officialSources.title: ICAO Handbook for Cabin Crew Recurrent Training
FAA Passenger Evacuations

editActions: organized the answer from securing the aircraft to boarding survival craft
emphasized usable exits and leaving baggage behind
provenance.riskAssessment: Exit usability and raft deployment are aircraft- and water-condition-specific, so the answer requires an external hazard assessment rather than naming fixed exits.

cards.answerZh: 飞机停止后，飞行员应按要求使飞机处于安全状态；如果留在机上不安全，就下令撤离。机组应只使用位于水面以上且没有危险的出口，展开可用的滑梯救生筏或救生筏，并指挥人员不要携带行李。所有人应进入救生筏、保持在一起，并使用救生和信号设备。

cards.questionEn: What can you see in this picture of an apparent tail-strike event?
cards.questionZh: 你能从这张疑似擦机尾事件的图片中看到什么？
cards.answerEn: The aircraft is rotating for takeoff with a high nose-up attitude. Its rear fuselage appears to be contacting or scraping the runway. This is consistent with a tail strike, although the amount of damage cannot be judged from the picture.

provenance.imageObservation: A passenger aircraft is nose-high during takeoff, and the lower rear fuselage is at or extremely close to the runway surface.
editActions: described the aircraft attitude and apparent contact point
qualified the event and avoided estimating damage
provenance.riskAssessment: The scene strongly suggests a tail strike, but the image alone cannot confirm the severity of contact or damage.

cards.answerZh: 飞机正以较大的机头上仰姿态抬轮起飞，其后机身似乎正在接触或擦碰跑道。这与擦尾现象相符，但无法从图片判断损伤程度。

cards.questionEn: How can takeoff weight affect the risk of a tail strike?
cards.questionZh: 起飞重量会如何影响擦机尾风险？
cards.answerEn: High takeoff weight is one factor that can increase the risk of a tail strike.
cards.answerZh: 较大的起飞重量是可能增加擦尾风险的因素之一。

cards.questionEn: How can a flight crew reduce the risk of a tail strike?
cards.questionZh: 飞行机组如何降低擦机尾风险？
cards.answerEn: The crew should brief the tail-strike threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate clearly, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, the takeoff should be delayed or rejected.
cards.answerZh: 机组应对擦尾威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，保持清晰协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，应推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.questionEn: What factors may have contributed to the ground-handling accident shown in this picture?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素可能促成图中所示的地面作业事故？
cards.answerEn: The aircraft appears to have collided with ground equipment near its forward fuselage. Possible contributing factors include poor communication, inadequate clearance, incorrect positioning, or a loss of control during towing or pushback. The picture alone cannot establish the exact cause.

provenance.imageObservation: Ground equipment is in contact with or extremely close to the lower forward fuselage, where visible damage appears to have occurred.
editActions: identified the apparent aircraft-ground-equipment contact
listed plausible human and positioning factors as qualified possibilities
provenance.riskAssessment: No sequence of events is visible, so the answer explicitly separates possible contributors from a confirmed accident cause.

cards.answerZh: 飞机的前机身附近似乎与地面设备发生碰撞。可能的促成因素包括沟通不畅、间距不足、位置错误，或牵引、推出时失去控制。仅凭图片无法确定确切原因。

cards.questionEn: How can ground-handling accidents involving aircraft be prevented?
cards.questionZh: 如何预防涉及航空器的地面作业事故？
cards.answerEn: The crew should recognize ground-handling risks early, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.answerZh: 机组应尽早识别地面保障风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.questionEn: What risks can snow and ice contamination on an aircraft pose to flight safety?
cards.questionZh: 航空器上的冰雪污染会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.answerEn: Snow and ice contamination can reduce lift and increase drag. It may also lead to inaccurate airspeed indications and possible control difficulty. These effects may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.answerZh: 冰雪污染会减小升力并增大阻力，还可能导致空速指示不准确和操纵困难。这些影响可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.questionEn: How can ice contamination on a wing affect aircraft performance and handling?
cards.questionZh: 机翼结冰污染会如何影响航空器性能和操纵特性？
cards.answerEn: Ice contamination changes the wing shape, reducing lift and increasing drag. It can raise the stall speed, reduce climb performance, and cause the wing to stall earlier and less predictably. It may also reduce control effectiveness and make the aircraft difficult to handle.

editActions: expanded the locked lift-and-drag effects into performance and handling consequences
removed unrelated instrument effects to keep the answer specific to wing contamination
provenance.riskAssessment: The severity depends on ice shape and location, so the answer describes general aerodynamic effects without assigning numerical penalties.

cards.answerZh: 冰污染会改变机翼外形，使升力减小、阻力增大。它会提高失速速度、降低爬升性能，并使机翼更早且更难预测地失速。它还可能降低操纵效能，使飞机难以操纵。

cards.questionEn: What should pilots do if snow or ice is found on critical aircraft surfaces before departure?
cards.questionZh: 起飞前发现航空器关键表面有冰雪时，飞行员应怎么做？
cards.answerEn: I would identify the snow or ice contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.answerZh: 我会识别冰雪污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.questionEn: What visible bird-strike damage can you identify in this photograph?
cards.questionZh: 你能从这张照片中识别出哪些明显的鸟击损伤？
cards.answerEn: Flames and smoke are visible around one engine, and birds can be seen close to the aircraft. The engine may have ingested one or more birds and suffered serious damage. Internal damage cannot be confirmed from the photograph.

provenance.imageObservation: Birds are visible near the aircraft, with flames and smoke around an engine area.
editActions: described the visible birds, fire, and smoke
qualified the possible ingestion and limited the damage assessment to what is visible
provenance.riskAssessment: The photograph suggests a bird-strike-related engine event but does not prove ingestion or reveal internal engine damage.

cards.answerZh: 一台发动机周围可以看到火焰和烟雾，飞机附近还有鸟。发动机可能吸入了一只或多只鸟并受到严重损伤。照片无法确认内部损伤。

cards.questionEn: What environmental and operational factors increase the risk of a bird strike?
cards.questionZh: 哪些环境和运行因素会增加鸟击风险？
cards.answerEn: Bird-strike risk is highest near airports and at low altitude during takeoff, climb, approach, and landing. It increases during migration periods and around wetlands, open water, grass, rubbish sites, or other places that attract birds. Dawn, dusk, poor visibility, and airport activities that disturb flocks can make detection and avoidance more difficult.

officialSources.title: FAA Wildlife Hazard Frequently Asked Questions

editActions: grouped the main altitude, seasonal, habitat, and visibility factors
kept the operational factors directly related to detection and bird concentration
provenance.riskAssessment: Bird activity varies by airport and species, so the answer describes common risk factors rather than a universal schedule.

cards.answerZh: 鸟击风险在机场附近以及起飞、爬升、进近和着陆的低高度阶段最高。迁徙季节，以及湿地、开阔水域、草地、垃圾场或其他吸引鸟类的地点附近，风险会增大。黎明、黄昏、低能见度，以及惊扰鸟群的机场活动，都可能使发现和避让更加困难。

cards.questionEn: What weather conditions can further reduce visibility during a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.questionZh: 夜间进近山区机场时，哪些天气条件会进一步降低能见度？
cards.answerEn: Low cloud, fog, rain, snow, and haze can all reduce visibility during a night approach. Blowing dust or snow may obscure the runway, while heavy precipitation on the windshield can make the lights harder to see. In mountainous terrain, cloud can also hide ridges and remove the few outside visual references available at night.

editActions: expanded the existing low-cloud, rain, and fog list
explained how mountainous terrain worsens the loss of visual references
provenance.riskAssessment: The answer names general weather hazards and does not assume the conditions shown at a particular airport.

cards.answerZh: 低云、雾、雨、雪和霾都会降低夜间进近时的能见度。风吹起的尘土或积雪可能遮蔽跑道，风挡上的强降水会使灯光更难看清。在山区，云层还可能遮住山脊，并使夜间本就有限的外部目视参照进一步减少。

cards.questionEn: How do runway lights help pilots during a night approach and landing?
cards.questionZh: 跑道灯光如何在夜间进近和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.answerEn: Runway lights improve situational awareness by giving pilots clearer information, supporting better monitoring, and providing more time to make safe decisions during a night approach and landing.
cards.answerZh: 跑道灯光能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并在夜间进近和着陆时留出更多时间作出安全决策，从而提高情景意识。

cards.questionEn: What should a pre-descent briefing cover before a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.questionZh: 夜间进近山区机场前，下降前简令应涵盖哪些内容？
cards.answerEn: The briefing should cover low cloud, rain, fog, terrain shadow, and limited visual references. It should also address careful aircraft monitoring and the need for conservative action if safety margins are reduced.
cards.answerZh: 简令应包括低云、降雨、雾、地形阴影和有限目视参照等内容。还应说明如何认真监控飞机，以及安全裕度降低时采取保守措施的必要性。

cards.questionEn: What can you see in this picture of a ground-fire emergency?
cards.questionZh: 你能从这张地面火灾紧急情况的图片中看到什么？
cards.answerEn: A passenger aircraft is on the ground with a major fire and heavy black smoke around it. Another aircraft is parked nearby, close to the burning aircraft. The fire appears intense, but its source and the condition of the occupants cannot be determined from the picture.

provenance.imageObservation: One aircraft is surrounded by flames and heavy smoke on the apron while another aircraft is positioned nearby.
editActions: described the visible ground fire and nearby aircraft
stated the limits of what can be determined from the image
provenance.riskAssessment: The source of the fire and the condition of occupants are not visible, so the answer avoids both operational assumptions and a mandatory evacuation conclusion.

cards.answerZh: 一架客机停在地面，周围发生严重火灾并冒出大量黑烟。另一架飞机停在附近，距离起火飞机很近。火势看起来非常猛烈，但无法从图片判断火源和机上人员状况。

cards.questionEn: What factors can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground?
cards.questionZh: 哪些因素会增加航空器在地面起火的风险？
cards.answerEn: Fuel, hot brakes, leaking fluids, and nearby ground equipment can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground.
cards.answerZh: 燃油、高温刹车、泄漏的液体和附近的地面设备都会增加飞机在地面起火的风险。

cards.questionEn: If your aircraft were parked near the burning aircraft shown, how would you protect your aircraft and its occupants?
cards.questionZh: 如果你的航空器停在图中起火航空器附近，你会如何保护自己的航空器及其乘员？
cards.answerEn: I would alert ground control and the cabin crew immediately and stop boarding or servicing activities. If there were enough time and it was safe and authorized, I would have the aircraft moved away from the fire. Otherwise, I would shut it down and evacuate through exits away from the flames and smoke, directing everyone to assemble upwind at a safe distance.

editActions: made movement of the aircraft conditional on safety and authorization
provided a clear shutdown and evacuation alternative
provenance.riskAssessment: Starting or moving an aircraft near a fire can create additional hazards, so the answer does not make relocation the automatic response.

cards.answerZh: 我会立即通知地面管制和客舱机组，并停止登机或保障作业。如果时间充足且安全并获得许可，我会让飞机移离火场。否则，我会关闭飞机，并通过远离火焰和烟雾的出口撤离，指挥所有人到上风向的安全距离集合。

cards.questionEn: Under what weather conditions are lightning strikes most likely to occur?
cards.questionZh: 雷击最可能在哪些天气条件下发生？
cards.answerEn: Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms or cumulonimbus clouds.
cards.answerZh: 雷击最可能发生在雷暴或积雨云中。

cards.questionEn: Why are lightning strikes hazardous to flight safety?
cards.questionZh: 为什么雷击会危及飞行安全？
cards.answerEn: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause electrical failure or disrupt communication and navigation systems.
cards.answerZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致电气故障，或使通信和导航系统中断。

cards.questionEn: What damage can a lightning strike cause to an aircraft?
cards.questionZh: 雷击会对飞机造成哪些损伤？
cards.answerEn: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause communication or navigation failure.
cards.answerZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致通信或导航失效。

cards.questionEn: During which phase of flight is an aircraft most likely to be struck by lightning?
cards.questionZh: 飞机在哪个飞行阶段最容易遭遇雷击？
cards.answerEn: An aircraft is most likely to be struck by lightning during climb, descent, or holding rather than at normal cruise altitude. These phases often take it through active cloud layers at lower altitudes. The risk is greatest near thunderstorms and at levels where the temperature is close to freezing.

officialSources.title: NASA Lightning Protection of Aircraft
FAA Aeronautical Information Manual, Safety of Flight

editActions: answered the phase-of-flight question directly
added the associated cloud and temperature conditions from official guidance
provenance.riskAssessment: Lightning can occur in other phases and even outside visible cloud, so the answer describes the most likely phases rather than an absolute rule.

cards.answerZh: 飞机在爬升、下降或等待阶段比在正常巡航高度更容易遭到雷击，因为这些阶段常会穿过较低高度的活跃云层。雷暴附近以及温度接近冰点的高度层风险最大。

cards.questionEn: Have you ever encountered icing conditions during flight?
cards.questionZh: 你在飞行中遇到过结冰条件吗？
cards.answerEn: No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. I know that icing can affect aircraft performance, so I try to avoid icing conditions during flight.
cards.answerZh: 没有，我从未在飞行中遇到过结冰。我知道结冰会影响飞机性能，因此会尽量避开结冰条件。

cards.questionEn: What cockpit or other indications can alert pilots to airframe icing?
cards.questionZh: 哪些驾驶舱指示或其他迹象可以提醒飞行员机体结冰？
cards.answerEn: Pilots may see ice building up on the windshield or wings. Reduced airspeed, changes in altitude or climb performance, and reports from ATC or other pilots can also provide warning. Some large aircraft have ice detectors that give a direct indication.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员可能看到风挡或机翼上开始积冰。空速下降、高度或爬升性能变化，以及空中交通管制或其他飞行员的报告，也能提供警示。一些大型飞机装有可直接提供指示的结冰探测器。

cards.questionEn: How can in-flight icing affect flight safety?
cards.questionZh: 空中结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.answerEn: In-flight icing may reduce lift, increase drag, and cause flight-control problems or a stall. It may also cause incorrect airspeed or altitude indications and may lead to engine vibration, flameout, or failure.
cards.answerZh: 飞行中结冰会减小升力、增大阻力，并可能导致飞行操纵问题或失速。它还可能造成空速或高度指示错误，并可能引起发动机振动、熄火或失效。

cards.questionEn: What should pilots do if they encounter icing conditions in flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中遇到结冰条件时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would turn on the pitot heating system, advise ATC of the situation, and request a route or flight-level change to avoid the icing conditions.
cards.answerZh: 我会打开空速管加温系统，向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变航路或飞行高度层，以避开结冰条件。

cards.questionEn: What should a pilot do if ice begins to accumulate on the wings in flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中机翼开始积冰时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: I would report the situation to ATC and request an altitude change to leave the icing area. I would also turn on the aircraft's de-icing and anti-icing systems.
cards.answerZh: 我会向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变高度以离开结冰区域。我还会打开飞机的除冰和防冰系统。

cards.questionEn: Under what atmospheric conditions is aircraft icing likely to occur?
cards.questionZh: 哪些大气条件下容易发生飞机结冰？
cards.answerEn: Aircraft icing is likely when the air and aircraft surface temperatures are below 0°C and there are enough supercooled droplets in the air. It is more likely in cold, humid conditions.
cards.answerZh: 当空气和飞机表面温度低于 0°C，且空气中有足够多的过冷水滴时，飞机容易结冰。寒冷潮湿条件下更容易发生结冰。

cards.questionEn: On which parts of an aircraft is ice most likely to form?
cards.questionZh: 飞机哪些部位最容易结冰？
cards.answerEn: Ice is most likely to form on exposed leading edges and critical components. These include the wings, windshield, engine air intakes, pitot tubes, static ports, radio antennas, and landing gear.
cards.answerZh: 冰最容易积聚在暴露的前缘和关键部件上，包括机翼、风挡、发动机进气口、空速管、静压孔、无线电天线和起落架。

cards.questionEn: What de-icing systems are installed on the aircraft you fly?
cards.questionZh: 你所飞的飞机安装了哪些除冰系统？
cards.answerEn: The aircraft I fly uses hot air, electrical heating, and de-icing fluid for ice protection.
cards.answerZh: 我所飞的飞机使用热空气、电加温和除冰液进行防冰保护。

cards.questionEn: How does an aircraft's anti-icing system work?
cards.questionZh: 飞机的防冰系统如何工作？
cards.answerEn: An aircraft anti-icing system uses electrical power or hot engine bleed air to heat critical surfaces. These may include the windshield, pitot tubes, wing leading edges, and engine intakes. The heat prevents ice from building up.
cards.answerZh: 飞机防冰系统利用电力或发动机热引气加热关键表面。这些表面可能包括风挡、空速管、机翼前缘和发动机进气口。加热可以防止冰层积聚。

cards.questionEn: What types of airframe ice can form in flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中可能形成哪些类型的机体积冰？
cards.answerEn: The common types of airframe ice are rime ice, clear ice, and mixed ice.
cards.answerZh: 常见的机体积冰类型包括雾凇冰、明冰和混合冰。

cards.questionEn: Which type of airframe ice poses the greatest threat to flight safety, and why?
cards.questionZh: 哪种类型的机体积冰对飞行安全威胁最大？为什么？
cards.answerEn: Clear ice poses the greatest threat. It can form a smooth, hard layer that changes the aerodynamic shape, is difficult to remove, and can accumulate quickly. This may lead to a loss of lift and control.
cards.answerZh: 明冰的威胁最大。它会形成光滑坚硬的冰层，改变气动外形，难以清除，而且可能迅速积聚。这可能导致升力和操纵能力丧失。

cards.questionEn: What is the difference between de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.questionZh: 除冰与防冰有什么区别？
cards.answerEn: De-icing removes ice, snow, or frost that has already accumulated on an aircraft. Anti-icing helps prevent new ice from forming after de-icing. Many operations use de-icing first and anti-icing second.
cards.answerZh: 除冰是清除已经积聚在飞机上的冰、雪或霜。防冰则是在除冰后帮助防止新的冰层形成。许多运行先除冰，随后再进行防冰。

cards.questionEn: What is holdover time in ground de-icing and anti-icing operations?
cards.questionZh: 在地面除冰和防冰作业中，什么是保持时间？
cards.answerEn: Holdover time is the estimated period during which anti-icing fluid protects an aircraft from ice, snow, or frost accumulation. It begins when the final anti-icing application starts and ends when the fluid loses effectiveness. It depends on the fluid type, weather, and precipitation intensity; if it expires before takeoff, new contamination may form and re-treatment may be needed.
cards.answerZh: 保持时间是指防冰液保护飞机免受冰、雪或霜积聚的预计时段。它从最后一次防冰液喷洒开始时计算，到防冰液失效时结束。保持时间取决于液体类型、天气和降水强度；如果起飞前超过保持时间，可能再次形成污染，需要重新处理。

cards.questionEn: What are the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids?
cards.questionZh: 常见的飞机除冰液和防冰液有哪些类型？
cards.answerEn: The four common fluid categories are Type I, Type II, Type III, and Type IV.
cards.answerZh: 常见的四类液体是 I 型、II 型、III 型和 IV 型。

cards.questionEn: How do the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids differ?
cards.questionZh: 常见类型的飞机除冰液和防冰液有何区别？
cards.answerEn: Type I is a thin, heated de-icing fluid that runs off quickly and provides a short holdover time. Type II is thicker and remains on the surface longer, while Type III is designed for smaller aircraft. Type IV is very thick and provides the longest holdover time.
cards.answerZh: I 型是黏度较低的加热除冰液，会很快流走，保持时间较短。II 型黏度更高，在表面停留时间更长；III 型适用于较小型飞机。IV 型黏度很高，保持时间最长。

cards.questionEn: Who is responsible for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is needed before takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 起飞前由谁负责决定是否需要除冰或防冰？
cards.answerEn: The pilot in command has final responsibility for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is required. The pilot should assess the weather and any contamination and may consult dispatch and ground de-icing personnel for technical advice. The final decision remains with the captain.
cards.answerZh: 是否需要除冰或防冰，最终由机长负责决定。机长应评估天气和任何污染情况，并可向签派和地面除冰人员征询技术意见。最终决定仍由机长作出。

cards.questionEn: How should the appropriate de-icing or anti-icing fluid be selected in heavy snow?
cards.questionZh: 大雪条件下应如何选择合适的除冰液或防冰液？
cards.answerEn: In heavy snow, a two-step process may use heated Type I fluid to remove existing contamination, followed by Type IV fluid for anti-icing. The crew should check the fluid's certified weather conditions.
cards.answerZh: 在大雪条件下，两步法可以先使用加热的 I 型液体清除已有污染，再使用 IV 型液体进行防冰。机组应核对该液体获准使用的天气条件。

cards.questionEn: What is wind shear?
cards.questionZh: 什么是风切变？
cards.answerEn: Wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed or direction over a short distance or within a small area. It can cause rapid changes in aircraft airspeed and altitude.
cards.answerZh: 风切变是风速或风向在很短距离或很小区域内突然发生变化。它会使飞机空速和高度迅速改变。

cards.questionEn: Where is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.questionZh: 风切变最可能在哪里发生？
cards.answerEn: Wind shear is most likely near thunderstorms and convective cells, especially close to the ground where microbursts can affect takeoff and approach. It can also occur near frontal weather and strong changes in surface wind. Low-level wind shear is particularly dangerous because there is little height available for recovery.

officialSources.title: FAA Terminal Doppler Weather Radar
FAA Lessons Learned: Low-Level Wind Shear

editActions: identified the main convective and non-convective locations
explained why low-level encounters are especially hazardous
provenance.riskAssessment: Wind shear has several meteorological and terrain-related causes, so the answer avoids presenting thunderstorms as the only location.

cards.answerZh: 风切变最容易发生在雷暴和强对流单体附近，尤其在接近地面的区域，微下击暴流会影响起飞和进近。它也可能出现在锋面天气和地面风发生强烈变化的区域。低空风切变特别危险，因为可用于改出的高度很少。

cards.questionEn: Have you ever received a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.questionZh: 你在飞行中收到过风切变警告吗？
cards.answerEn: No, I have never received a wind shear warning in flight. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and that aircraft does not have a wind shear warning system.
cards.answerZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未收到过风切变警告。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有风切变警告系统。

cards.questionEn: What are the possible consequences if a pilot ignores a wind shear warning?
cards.questionZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，可能会造成哪些后果？
cards.answerEn: If a pilot ignores a wind shear warning, the aircraft may experience sudden airspeed and altitude changes. It may become difficult to control and could stall or crash.
cards.answerZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，飞机的空速和高度可能突然变化。飞机可能变得难以操纵，并可能失速或坠毁。

cards.questionEn: How are pilots warned about wind shear on your aircraft?
cards.questionZh: 你所飞的飞机通过什么方式向飞行员发出风切变警告？
cards.answerEn: The DA-40 I fly does not have a wind shear warning system. On large commercial aircraft, weather radar and EGPWS can provide a wind shear warning to the pilots.
cards.answerZh: 我飞的 DA-40 没有风切变警告系统。在大型商用飞机上，气象雷达和 EGPWS 可以向飞行员提供风切变警告。

cards.questionEn: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.questionZh: 为什么风切变会威胁飞行安全？
cards.answerEn: Wind shear can cause sudden increases or decreases in airspeed and a rapid loss of altitude. The aircraft may become difficult to control, stall, or crash.
cards.answerZh: 风切变会使空速突然增大或减小，并造成高度迅速下降。飞机可能变得难以操纵、失速，甚至坠毁。

cards.questionEn: Have you ever encountered wind shear in flight?
cards.questionZh: 你在飞行中遇到过风切变吗？
cards.answerEn: Yes, I once encountered wind shear during a training flight. The aircraft's speed and altitude changed abruptly. I maintained control, communicated with ATC, and adjusted the flight parameters to recover from the situation.
cards.answerZh: 是的，我曾在一次训练飞行中遭遇风切变。飞机的速度和高度突然变化。我控制好飞机，与空中交通管制沟通，并调整飞行参数，使飞机恢复正常状态。

cards.questionEn: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during the takeoff roll before V1?
cards.questionZh: 在 V1 前的起飞滑跑阶段遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: Before V1, the pilots should reject the takeoff by reducing power, using rudder to keep the aircraft straight, and applying the brakes to stop on the runway.
cards.answerZh: 在 V1 之前，飞行员应减小推力，使用方向舵保持飞机直线，并使用刹车使飞机停在跑道上，从而中断起飞。

cards.questionEn: What would you do if you encountered wind shear and a sudden loss of airspeed as the aircraft approached rotation speed?
cards.questionZh: 飞机接近抬前轮速度时，如果遭遇风切变并且空速突然下降，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: If the event were recognized before the takeoff decision speed and a safe rejection could be initiated, I would maintain directional control and reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue, rotate normally at the calculated rotation speed, and follow the wind-shear escape guidance. I would avoid configuration changes until the aircraft was clear of the shear.

officialSources.title: FAA Airplane Flying Handbook, Rejected Takeoff

editActions: resolved the near-rotation ambiguity with a decision-speed condition
used the existing wind-shear escape principle after a continued takeoff
provenance.riskAssessment: The question does not state the aircraft's position relative to V1, so a single unconditional reject or continue instruction would be unsafe.

cards.answerZh: 如果在起飞决断速度之前识别到该情况，并且能够安全中断起飞，我会保持方向控制并按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，按计算的抬轮速度正常抬轮，并遵循风切变逃逸指引。在飞机脱离风切变之前，我会避免改变构型。

cards.questionEn: How can wind shear cause an aircraft to deviate from the glide slope during approach?
cards.questionZh: 进近过程中，风切变如何导致飞机偏离下滑道？
cards.answerEn: A sudden increase in headwind can raise indicated airspeed and lift, causing the aircraft to move above the glide slope. A downdraft or a change to tailwind can reduce airspeed and lift and push it below the glide slope. Because these changes can occur quickly, large corrections may make the approach unstable.

editActions: explained both upward and downward glide-slope deviations
connected rapid wind changes to approach stability
provenance.riskAssessment: Actual flight-path response depends on wind vector, automation, and pilot inputs, so the answer describes typical effects rather than a fixed sequence.

cards.answerZh: 顶风突然增强会使指示空速和升力增大，导致飞机高于下滑道。下沉气流或变为顺风会使空速和升力减小，并将飞机推至下滑道以下。由于这些变化可能迅速发生，过大的修正会使进近变得不稳定。

cards.questionEn: Why is low-level wind shear more hazardous than wind shear at higher altitudes?
cards.questionZh: 为什么低空风切变比高空风切变更危险？
cards.answerEn: Low-level wind shear occurs close to the ground, often during takeoff, climb, approach, or landing. A sudden loss of airspeed or altitude leaves less time and height for recovery, and nearby terrain or buildings may be difficult to clear.
cards.answerZh: 低空风切变发生在接近地面的区域，通常出现在起飞、爬升、进近或着陆阶段。空速或高度突然下降会使飞行员用于改出的时间和高度更少，附近地形或建筑物也可能难以越过。

cards.questionEn: How should pilots respond to a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中收到风切变警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: During takeoff, the pilots should maintain control, add power, and leave the wind shear area. During landing, they should go around.
cards.answerZh: 起飞过程中，飞行员应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。着陆过程中则应复飞。

cards.questionEn: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 起飞过程中遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: If wind shear is encountered before V1, the pilots should not continue the takeoff. If it is encountered after V1, they should maintain aircraft control, add power, and leave the wind shear area.
cards.answerZh: 如果在 V1 之前遭遇风切变，飞行员不应继续起飞。如果在 V1 之后遭遇，应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。

cards.questionEn: How can wind shear affect aircraft performance?
cards.questionZh: 风切变会如何影响飞机性能？
cards.answerEn: Wind shear may cause the aircraft's airspeed to increase or decrease, and it may cause a loss of altitude.
cards.answerZh: 风切变可能使飞机空速增大或减小，也可能造成高度损失。

cards.questionEn: What would you do if low-level wind shear were forecast for takeoff?
cards.questionZh: 如果预报起飞时会出现低空风切变，你会如何处置？
cards.answerEn: If low-level wind shear were forecast before takeoff, I would delay the takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.answerZh: 如果起飞前预报有低空风切变，我会推迟起飞或改用另一条跑道。

cards.questionEn: How can pilots recognize that they have encountered wind shear?
cards.questionZh: 飞行员如何判断飞机已经遭遇风切变？
cards.answerEn: Pilots may recognize wind shear from sudden changes in airspeed, ground speed, or vertical speed.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员可以通过空速、地速或垂直速度突然变化来识别风切变。

cards.questionEn: What measures can help reduce accidents caused by wind shear?
cards.questionZh: 哪些措施有助于减少风切变造成的事故？
cards.answerEn: Pilots can check forecasts, ATIS, and NOTAMs before flight and avoid takeoff or landing in areas affected by wind shear. In flight, they can use weather radar and pilot reports and monitor wind changes. Training, predictive wind shear systems, and timely ATC alerts also help reduce accidents.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员可以在飞行前查看预报、ATIS 和航行通告，并避免在受风切变影响的区域起飞或着陆。飞行中可以利用气象雷达和飞行员报告，并监控风的变化。训练、预测式风切变系统以及空中交通管制及时发出的警告也有助于减少事故。

cards.questionEn: During which seasons is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.questionZh: 哪些季节最容易出现风切变？
cards.answerEn: The season depends on the local climate, so there is no single answer worldwide. Convective wind shear is most likely during the local thunderstorm season, while frontal and inversion-related wind shear can occur at other times. Pilots should use current forecasts, reports, and local weather patterns rather than relying only on the time of year.

officialSources.title: FAA Aviation Weather Handbook
National Weather Service Flight Environment — Wind Shear

editActions: rejected an unsafe universal seasonal rule
distinguished convective and frontal or inversion-related wind shear
provenance.riskAssessment: Seasonality depends strongly on climate and location, so the answer emphasizes local forecasts and observations.

cards.answerZh: 具体季节取决于当地气候，因此全球没有统一答案。对流性风切变最常见于当地雷暴季节，而锋面或逆温相关的风切变也可能在其他时段发生。飞行员应依据当前预报、报告和当地天气规律，而不能只看季节。

cards.questionEn: What emergency equipment is available in the cockpit of the aircraft you fly?
cards.questionZh: 你所飞飞机的驾驶舱内配备了哪些应急设备？
cards.answerEn: The example DA-40 I use for training carries a portable fire extinguisher within reach of the pilots and the emergency equipment required by its approved equipment list. It does not have transport-aircraft equipment such as quick-donning masks, protective breathing equipment, or escape ropes. Before flight, I verify the equipment actually installed and required for the planned operation.

editActions: removed the conflicting transport-aircraft equipment list
aligned the answer with the illustrative DA-40 configuration and approved equipment list
provenance.riskAssessment: Exact portable and mission equipment varies, so the answer requires verification of the actual aircraft.

cards.answerZh: 我用于训练的示例 DA-40 在飞行员触手可及的位置配有便携式灭火器，并携带其批准设备清单规定的应急设备。它没有快戴式面罩、防护式呼吸设备或逃生绳等运输机设备。飞行前，我会核实飞机实际安装的设备以及本次运行所需的设备。

cards.questionEn: Does the aircraft type you fly have evacuation slides? If so, where are they located?
cards.questionZh: 你所飞的机型配有撤离滑梯吗？如果有，安装在哪里？
cards.answerEn: No. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and it does not have evacuation slides.
cards.answerZh: 没有。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有撤离滑梯。

cards.questionEn: Under what circumstances should evacuation slides be used?
cards.questionZh: 在什么情况下应使用撤离滑梯？
cards.answerEn: Evacuation slides should be deployed when an emergency evacuation is required, for example because of a bomb on board, an engine fire, or smoke in the cabin.
cards.answerZh: 需要紧急撤离时应放出撤离滑梯，例如机上有炸弹、发动机起火或客舱出现烟雾。

cards.questionEn: Have you ever heard of an evacuation slide being deployed accidentally during ground operations?
cards.questionZh: 你听说过地面运行期间撤离滑梯意外释放的情况吗？
cards.answerEn: Yes. I heard about a passenger opening an overwing emergency exit on the ground, which caused the slide to deploy.
cards.answerZh: 是的。我听说过一名旅客在地面打开翼上应急出口，导致滑梯放出的事件。

cards.questionEn: Why are pilots required to be familiar with emergency equipment?
cards.questionZh: 为什么要求飞行员熟悉应急设备？
cards.answerEn: Pilots need to know the location and function of emergency equipment so they can use it quickly and correctly during an emergency.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员需要了解应急设备的位置和功能，以便在紧急情况下快速、正确地使用。

cards.questionEn: How easy is the emergency equipment on your aircraft to use?
cards.questionZh: 你所飞飞机上的应急设备是否容易使用？
cards.answerEn: The emergency equipment on my aircraft is designed to be easy to reach and convenient to use. It includes fire extinguishers, oxygen masks, a flashlight, a first-aid kit, and life vests.
cards.answerZh: 我所飞机型的应急设备设计得便于接近和使用，包括灭火器、氧气面罩、手电筒、急救箱和救生衣。

cards.questionEn: What functions do evacuation slides serve?
cards.questionZh: 撤离滑梯有哪些用途？
cards.answerEn: Evacuation slides help people on board leave the aircraft as quickly as possible during an evacuation.
cards.answerZh: 撤离滑梯可以帮助机上人员在撤离时尽快离开飞机。

cards.questionEn: What assistance might a flight crew need from ATC or ground personnel during an emergency?
cards.questionZh: 紧急情况下，机组可能需要 ATC 或地面人员提供哪些协助？
cards.answerEn: The crew may need ATC to coordinate a priority landing and the necessary airspace and to provide updated weather information. ATC or ground personnel may also arrange fire, rescue, medical, and airport police services.
cards.answerZh: 机组可能需要空中交通管制协调优先着陆和所需空域，并提供最新天气信息。空中交通管制或地面人员还可以安排消防、救援、医疗和机场公安等服务。

cards.questionEn: When is an emergency descent necessary?
cards.questionZh: 何时需要实施紧急下降？
cards.answerEn: An emergency descent may be necessary after a decompression or a pressurization-system failure. It may also be needed when there is uncontrollable smoke or fire in flight.
cards.answerZh: 发生失压或增压系统故障后，可能需要紧急下降。飞行中出现无法控制的烟雾或火灾时，也可能需要这样做。

cards.questionEn: What procedures should a pilot follow during an emergency descent?
cards.questionZh: 紧急下降过程中，飞行员应遵循哪些程序？
cards.answerEn: The pilot should put on an oxygen mask, notify the crew and passengers, complete the recall items, and follow the aircraft's emergency descent profile. The pilot should monitor the instruments and communicate with the crew. If time permits, the pilot should advise ATC of the situation.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员应戴上氧气面罩，通知机组和旅客，完成记忆项目，并按照该机型的紧急下降剖面操作。飞行员应监控仪表并与机组沟通。如果时间允许，还应向空中交通管制报告情况。

cards.questionEn: What assistance can ATC provide during an emergency descent?
cards.questionZh: ATC 在紧急下降过程中可以提供哪些协助？
cards.answerEn: ATC can issue the necessary clearance, advise other aircraft that an emergency descent is in progress, and help provide separation. It can also provide information about the flight conditions and the en-route minimum altitude.
cards.answerZh: 空中交通管制可以发布必要的许可，通知其他飞机正在进行紧急下降，并协助提供间隔。它还可以提供飞行条件和航路最低高度等信息。

cards.questionEn: What can cause an aircraft to make a belly landing?
cards.questionZh: 哪些情况会导致飞机进行机腹着陆？
cards.answerEn: A belly landing may be necessary if the pilot forgets to extend the landing gear or if a mechanical problem prevents the gear from extending.
cards.answerZh: 如果飞行员忘记放起落架，或机械故障使起落架无法放下，可能需要进行机腹着陆。

cards.questionEn: How should a flight crew prepare for a belly landing?
cards.questionZh: 机组应如何为机腹着陆做准备？
cards.answerEn: The crew should inform ATC and request fire and medical services. The cabin crew should prepare the passengers to fasten their seat belts, brace for impact, and be ready for evacuation. The passengers should remain calm and follow the cabin crew's instructions.
cards.answerZh: 机组应通知空中交通管制并申请消防和医疗服务。客舱机组应让旅客系好安全带、采取防冲击姿势，并做好撤离准备。旅客应保持冷静并听从客舱机组指令。

cards.questionEn: How dangerous is a belly landing, and why?
cards.questionZh: 机腹着陆有多危险？为什么？
cards.answerEn: A belly landing is very dangerous because it may cause structural damage to the aircraft, start a fire, and injure people on board.
cards.answerZh: 机腹着陆非常危险，因为它可能造成飞机结构损伤、引发火灾，并使机上人员受伤。

cards.questionEn: What factors should a pilot consider before deciding to make a belly landing?
cards.questionZh: 在决定进行机腹着陆前，飞行员应考虑哪些因素？
cards.answerEn: Before deciding on a belly landing, the pilot should consider the aircraft's weight and landing speed, the weather and runway conditions, and the available ground services.
cards.answerZh: 决定进行机腹着陆前，飞行员应考虑飞机重量和着陆速度、天气和跑道状况，以及可用的地面保障服务。

cards.questionEn: What actions should a pilot take when carrying out a belly landing?
cards.questionZh: 实施机腹着陆时，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.answerEn: The pilot should report the situation to ATC and request an emergency landing, fire services, and medical services. After landing, the crew should carry out an emergency evacuation if required.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员应向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请紧急着陆、消防和医疗服务。着陆后，机组应在需要时实施紧急撤离。

cards.questionEn: What is the difference between an urgency situation and a distress situation?
cards.questionZh: 紧急情况与遇险情况有什么区别？
cards.answerEn: An urgency situation requires prompt attention but not immediate assistance, and the signal is PAN PAN. A distress situation requires immediate assistance because there is a serious threat to the aircraft or to life, and the signal is MAYDAY.
cards.answerZh: 紧迫情况需要及时关注，但不需要立即援助，其信号是 PAN PAN。遇险情况表示飞机或人员生命受到严重威胁，需要立即援助，其信号是 MAYDAY。

cards.questionEn: How should a pilot transmit a distress message?
cards.questionZh: 飞行员应如何发送遇险信息？
cards.answerEn: The pilot should begin with “Mayday” repeated three times and address the station being called. The message should give the aircraft identification and type, the nature of the distress, the pilot's intentions, position, heading, altitude, fuel endurance in minutes, and number of people on board. Relevant weather and any other useful information should be added when time permits.

officialSources.title: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual, Distress and Urgency Procedures

editActions: organized the distress call in the standard transmission order
kept the answer suitable for oral practice without inventing a sample emergency
provenance.riskAssessment: A pilot may transmit only the information time and circumstances permit; the answer presents the preferred elements rather than an inflexible script.

cards.answerZh: 飞行员应先连续三次呼叫“Mayday”，并呼叫目标电台。报文应包括飞机识别标志和机型、遇险性质、飞行员意图、位置、航向、高度、以分钟表示的续航时间，以及机上人数。如果时间允许，还应补充相关天气和其他有用信息。

cards.questionEn: What should a pilot do after hearing another aircraft transmit a distress message in flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中听到另一架飞机发送遇险信息后，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: If the distressed aircraft can communicate with ATC, I would stop transmitting. If it cannot, I would help relay the message to ATC and provide any necessary assistance.
cards.answerZh: 如果遇险飞机能够与空中交通管制通信，我会停止发射。如果它无法通信，我会协助向空中交通管制转发报文，并提供必要帮助。

cards.questionEn: Are all the aircraft in your company's fleet equipped with CVRs?
cards.questionZh: 你所在公司机队的所有飞机都配备 CVR 吗？
cards.answerEn: I am not employed by a company with an operating fleet. The DA-40 I use for flight training is not equipped with a cockpit voice recorder. In commercial operations, whether every aircraft requires a CVR depends on the applicable regulations, aircraft category, and operation.

editActions: removed the conflicting company-fleet claim
answered for the locked DA-40 training context and qualified commercial CVR applicability
provenance.riskAssessment: No real fleet equipment status is claimed, and CVR requirements are not presented as universal.

cards.answerZh: 我尚未受雇于拥有运行机队的公司。我用于飞行训练的 DA-40 没有安装驾驶舱话音记录器。在商业运行中，是否每架飞机都必须配备 CVR，取决于适用法规、飞机类别和运行类型。

cards.questionEn: What is the main purpose of a CVR?
cards.questionZh: CVR 的主要用途是什么？
cards.answerEn: A cockpit voice recorder records communications, warnings, and other relevant sounds in the cockpit. The recordings can provide important evidence for an accident or incident investigation.
cards.answerZh: 驾驶舱话音记录器会记录驾驶舱内的通信、警告声和其他相关声音。这些录音可以为事故或事件调查提供重要证据。

cards.questionEn: What types of audio does a CVR record in the cockpit?
cards.questionZh: CVR 会记录驾驶舱内哪些类型的声音？
cards.answerEn: A CVR records conversations among the flight crew, radio transmissions with ATC, interphone communication between the flight deck and cabin, and audible caution or warning signals in the cockpit.
cards.answerZh: CVR 会记录飞行机组之间的交谈、与空中交通管制的无线电通信、驾驶舱与客舱之间的内话通信，以及驾驶舱内可听见的注意或警告信号。

cards.questionEn: What recording-duration requirements apply to CVRs under ICAO standards?
cards.questionZh: 根据 ICAO 标准，CVR 适用哪些记录时长要求？
cards.answerEn: ICAO standards require a cockpit voice recorder to retain at least the last two hours of operation. For an aeroplane with a maximum certificated takeoff mass above 27,000 kilograms whose individual certificate of airworthiness was first issued on or after 1 January 2021, the CVR must retain at least the last 25 hours. Older aircraft may therefore have a different required recording duration from newer aircraft.

officialSources.title: ICAO Annex 6, Part I — Operation of Aircraft

editActions: stated the general two-hour requirement
added the specific 25-hour applicability threshold and date
provenance.riskAssessment: The applicability of the 25-hour requirement depends on mass and the individual certificate date, so those conditions are stated explicitly.

cards.answerZh: ICAO 标准要求驾驶舱话音记录器至少保留最近两小时的运行录音。对于最大审定起飞质量超过 27,000 千克，且单机适航证于 2021 年一月 1 日或之后首次颁发的飞机，CVR 必须至少保留最近 25 小时的录音。因此，较老飞机与较新飞机适用的记录时长要求可能不同。

cards.questionEn: How does a CVR help investigators determine the causes of an aircraft accident?
cards.questionZh: CVR 如何帮助调查人员确定航空器事故原因？
cards.answerEn: A CVR gives investigators audio evidence from before and during an accident. They can analyze cockpit conversations and sounds to understand the crew's actions, decisions, communication, and the situation in the cockpit.
cards.answerZh: CVR 为调查人员提供事故发生前和发生时的音频证据。他们可以分析驾驶舱对话和声音，了解机组的行动、决策、沟通以及驾驶舱内的情况。

cards.questionEn: How do older CVRs differ from modern CVRs?
cards.questionZh: 早期 CVR 与现代 CVR 有何不同？
cards.answerEn: Modern CVRs generally have longer recording durations, better sound quality, more durable fire- and impact-resistant casings, and better compatibility with advanced aircraft systems than older CVRs.
cards.answerZh: 与较老的 CVR 相比，现代 CVR 通常记录时间更长、音质更好，防火抗冲击外壳更坚固，并且与先进飞机系统的兼容性更好。

cards.questionEn: Why are CVRs designed to be highly visible?
cards.questionZh: 为什么 CVR 要设计得非常醒目？
cards.answerEn: High visibility makes a CVR easier to locate and recover at an accident site, especially among debris, in water, or in low-light conditions.
cards.answerZh: 醒目的外观使 CVR 在事故现场更容易被发现和回收，尤其是在残骸中、水中或光线较暗的环境里。

cards.questionEn: What should the crew do if the CVR malfunctions during a flight?
cards.questionZh: 飞行中 CVR 发生故障时，机组应如何处置？
cards.answerEn: The crew should follow the applicable procedure, record the malfunction in the flight log, and inform ATC if required. After landing, they should report the problem to maintenance for repair.
cards.answerZh: 机组应遵循适用程序，在飞行记录本中记录故障，并在需要时通知空中交通管制。着陆后，应向维修部门报告问题并安排修理。

cards.questionEn: What ICAO standards govern whether a CVR must be installed on an aircraft?
cards.questionZh: 哪些 ICAO 标准规定了飞机是否必须安装 CVR？
cards.answerEn: ICAO Annex 6 bases CVR requirements mainly on mass, engine type, crew requirement, and certification dates. Aeroplanes above 5,700 kilograms with an individual certificate of airworthiness first issued on or after 1 January 1987 must have a CVR. Turbine aeroplanes above 2,250 and up to 5,700 kilograms with a type-certification application on or after 1 January 2016 and requiring more than one pilot must have a CVR or a cockpit audio recording system.

officialSources.title: ICAO Annex 6, Part I — Operation of Aircraft

editActions: summarized the governing applicability factors
included two representative thresholds with their date and crew conditions
provenance.riskAssessment: Older aeroplanes and other categories have additional detailed provisions, so the answer presents the main rules rather than claiming to reproduce every Annex 6 case.

cards.answerZh: ICAO 附件 6 主要依据飞机质量、发动机类型、机组要求和审定日期规定 CVR 要求。最大质量超过 5,700 千克，且单机适航证于 1987 年一月 1 日或之后首次颁发的飞机必须配备 CVR。最大质量超过 2,250 千克且不超过 5,700 千克、型号合格证申请日期为 2016 年一月 1 日或之后，并且需要多于一名飞行员的涡轮飞机，必须配备 CVR 或驾驶舱音频记录系统。

cards.questionEn: How is a CVR test performed?
cards.questionZh: 如何进行 CVR 测试？
cards.answerEn: A CVR test can generally be performed by pressing the CVR test button.
cards.answerZh: 通常可以按下 CVR 测试按钮来进行 CVR 测试。

cards.questionEn: How does a CVR store its audio recordings?
cards.questionZh: CVR 如何存储录音？
cards.answerEn: Microphones send audio signals to the CVR, which digitizes and stores them. Modern CVRs usually store the recordings in solid-state memory.
cards.answerZh: 麦克风将音频信号传送给 CVR，由 CVR 将其数字化并存储。现代 CVR 通常把录音保存在固态存储器中。

cards.questionEn: What is a flight data recorder (FDR)?
cards.questionZh: 什么是飞行数据记录器（FDR）？
cards.answerEn: FDR stands for flight data recorder. It records flight parameters such as airspeed, altitude, attitude, thrust, and control inputs for later analysis.
cards.answerZh: FDR 是飞行数据记录器的缩写。它记录空速、高度、姿态、推力和操纵输入等飞行参数，以供之后分析。

cards.questionEn: What is an FDR used for?
cards.questionZh: FDR 有什么用途？
cards.answerEn: An FDR records flight parameters so investigators can track the aircraft's status and performance. The data helps authorities determine accident causes and improve flight safety.
cards.answerZh: FDR 记录飞行参数，使调查人员能够追踪飞机状态和性能。这些数据有助于有关部门确定事故原因并提高飞行安全。

cards.questionEn: What is your opinion of your company's policy on using CVR recordings to monitor flight crews?
cards.questionZh: 你如何看待你所在公司关于使用 CVR 录音监控飞行机组的政策？
cards.answerEn: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company policy on CVR monitoring. In my opinion, recordings should be used only for legitimate safety, investigation, or authorised training purposes, with tightly controlled access and proper privacy protection. They should not be used unfairly for routine punishment.

editActions: provided a balanced personal opinion
retained the locked safety benefits while adding privacy and fair-use limits
provenance.riskAssessment: The answer states that the speaker has no company policy and gives only a general privacy-protective opinion.

cards.answerZh: 我尚未受雇于航空公司，因此没有公司的 CVR 监听政策。在我看来，录音只能用于正当的安全、调查或经授权的培训目的，并应严格控制访问权限、妥善保护机组隐私。不应把录音不公正地用于日常惩罚。

cards.questionEn: Does CVR monitoring affect your performance or freedom of action during flight?
cards.questionZh: CVR 监控会影响你在飞行中的表现或行动自由吗？
cards.answerEn: CVR monitoring does not prevent me from taking any action needed for safety. It makes me more conscious of using professional language, standard callouts, and clear coordination. My decisions are still based on the situation, the SOPs, and my responsibility for the flight.

editActions: answered both performance and freedom-of-action aspects directly
framed the effect as improved discipline rather than inhibited safety decisions
provenance.riskAssessment: This is an independent sample response and does not claim how real crews react to monitoring.

cards.answerZh: CVR 监听不会阻止我采取任何安全所需的行动。它会让我更加注意使用专业语言、标准口令和清晰协调。我的决策仍以实际情况、标准操作程序和我对飞行承担的责任为依据。

cards.questionEn: What is your understanding of crew resource management?
cards.questionZh: 你如何理解机组资源管理？
cards.answerEn: Crew resource management means using communication, cooperation, and teamwork to manage all available resources safely. It includes task sharing, decision-making, situational awareness, and the use of both onboard and ground resources to reduce human error.
cards.answerZh: 机组资源管理是指通过沟通、合作和团队协作，安全地管理所有可用资源。它包括任务分工、决策、情景意识，以及对机上和地面资源的利用，从而减少人为差错。

cards.questionEn: How should a captain and first officer communicate effectively?
cards.questionZh: 机长和副驾驶应如何进行有效沟通？
cards.answerEn: The captain and first officer should communicate openly and exchange their ideas. They should also follow the applicable procedures and company policy.
cards.answerZh: 机长和副驾驶应开放沟通并交换意见。他们还应遵守适用程序和公司政策。

cards.questionEn: How should pilots communicate effectively with cabin crew?
cards.questionZh: 飞行员应如何与客舱机组进行有效沟通？
cards.answerEn: Pilots and cabin crew should respect one another and each other's opinions. The captain should help the whole crew follow the applicable procedures and company policy.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员和客舱机组应相互尊重，也应尊重彼此的意见。机长应帮助全体机组遵守适用程序和公司政策。

cards.questionEn: How should pilots and ATC cooperate during normal and abnormal situations?
cards.questionZh: 在正常和非正常情况下，飞行员与空中交通管制部门应如何协作？
cards.answerEn: During normal operations, pilots and ATC should use standard phraseology, speak clearly, confirm any unclear instruction, and exchange relevant flight and weather information. During an abnormal situation, the pilots should report the problem promptly, and ATC should provide appropriate assistance and coordination.
cards.answerZh: 正常运行中，飞行员与空中交通管制应使用标准通话用语、表达清楚、核实任何不明确的指令，并交换相关飞行和天气信息。出现非正常情况时，飞行员应及时报告问题，空中交通管制则应提供适当的协助与协调。

cards.questionEn: Why should pilots understand the duties of cabin crew?
cards.questionZh: 飞行员为什么应当了解客舱机组的职责？
cards.answerEn: Pilots and cabin crew work as one team, so pilots should understand the cabin crew's duties. This knowledge helps them cooperate, offer appropriate support and instructions, and work more effectively during an emergency.
cards.answerZh: 飞行员和客舱机组是一个团队，因此飞行员应了解客舱机组的职责。这些知识有助于双方合作、提供适当支持和指令，并在紧急情况下更有效地协同工作。

cards.questionEn: What does CRM stand for?
cards.questionZh: CRM 是什么的缩写？
cards.answerEn: CRM stands for crew resource management. It is a process of using available people, equipment, and procedures to achieve a safe and efficient flight operation.
cards.answerZh: CRM 是机组资源管理的缩写。它是利用可用人员、设备和程序，实现安全高效飞行运行的过程。

cards.questionEn: Can you give an example of poor CRM contributing to an aviation accident or incident?
cards.questionZh: 你能否举例说明不良的机组资源管理如何导致航空事故或事件？
cards.answerEn: United Airlines Flight 173 is an example. The captain became focused on a landing-gear problem during approach and did not respond effectively to warnings about the remaining fuel. The engines lost power after the fuel was exhausted, and the aircraft crashed.
cards.answerZh: 美国联合航空 173 号航班就是一个例子。进近期间，机长过度专注于起落架问题，没有有效回应剩余燃油警告。燃油耗尽后发动机失去动力，飞机最终坠毁。

cards.questionEn: How could CRM training be improved in your company?
cards.questionZh: 你所在公司的 CRM 培训可以如何改进？
cards.answerEn: I am not employed by an airline, so I cannot assess a company CRM programme from personal experience. A company could improve CRM training through realistic scenarios, more joint training for pilots and cabin crew, and structured debriefings based on operational reports. This would help crews practise communication, workload management, and decision-making as one team.

editActions: removed the conflicting company-programme claim
